tagline: Documentary-style explainers: archive pictures cut on every phrase, receipt cards with the key words in lime on a royal-blue canvas, and white mono captions in black boxes. Also cuts your two-camera podcast into calm, boxed-caption clips.
needs: a voice-over (+ your own archive photos, optional)
readiness_note: Best with your own photos of the people and places you name; without them every picture is a created plate. Map cards are schematic until the geo-map bundle ships.

captions: F-A hook: archive subject, Ken Burns, boxed mono caption
F-A receipt: the headline types on, the key figure turns lime, leader line and thumbs
F-B podcast clip: speaker single with brand-blue boxed captions, then the QR end card
